name: 04_add_method
task: In 1C Configurator, extension 'api', HTTP service 'api_http': the new URL template 'api_test3p' exists. Add an HTTP method GET to it and create its handler procedure. Do not save the configuration.
rules: Work only with the new URL template api_test3p, its new method and their property windows. Never change demo_status, GET of demo_status or other existing objects. Do not delete anything. Do not use the main menu.

subgoals.goal: RIGHT-CLICK on the tree node 'api_test3p' in the right window, then in the context menu click 'Добавить', and in its submenu click 'Метод'.
subgoals.check: A new HTTP method was added to api_test3p: a child node (like 'Метод1') under api_test3p in the tree, or a properties window titled like 'Свойства: Метод1'.

subgoals.goal: In the properties window of the new method under api_test3p (named like 'Метод1'), set the field 'Имя' to GET using set_field on the value cell right of 'Имя'.
subgoals.check: The properties window of the new method under api_test3p shows name GET (title 'Свойства: GET' or field 'Имя' = GET) and it is the child of api_test3p.

subgoals.goal: Make sure the field 'HTTP-метод' of this method is GET. If it already shows GET, answer done. If not, click the dropdown of 'HTTP-метод' and choose GET.
subgoals.check: In the properties window of the method, the field 'HTTP-метод' shows GET.

subgoals.goal: Create the handler: click the small magnifier button at the right end of the field 'Обработчик' in the method's properties window. 1C will create a new procedure and open the module.
subgoals.check: A code module editor is open showing a procedure whose name contains api_test3p (for example 'Функция api_test3pGET(Запрос)' or 'Процедура ...').
